title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL via Ollama
slug_note: NVIDIA's 120B vision MoE in one command; the tag is 80-90 GB, so 128 GB machines.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's default `nemotron-3.5-super:latest` (120b) tag, 80GB - 90GB; quant not named on the page
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama list` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-24)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark: 97.1 GB resident at Ollama's default 256K context (weights + KV). Smaller boxes get a smaller default context and less KV. Earlier estimate: Estimate from the 80-90 GB tag plus KV headroom. Not measured.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

measurements.method: spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 638-token prompt
spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 4669-token prompt

spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 4669-token prompt, Ollama prompt_eval timing
drop in MemAvailable from cold (OS file cache dropped) to loaded after `ollama run nemotron-3.5-super`, at the default context Ollama chose (262144 tokens)

caveats: Ollama 0.40.10 on a 128 GB DGX Spark picked a 256K default context by itself, so memory use is well above the file size. Set num_ctx lower to save memory, or keep it for long documents.
No speed or memory numbers recorded yet; the size is Ollama's listed tag range.
Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-24): `ollama run nemotron-3.5-super` answered after 18.6 s from a cold start (model files read from disk).
